output.summary: A semi-deciduous flowering tree native to Central and South America, it forms a broad, symmetrical umbrella-shaped crown. Its leaves fold in rainy weather and at night, while its pods contain sticky edible pulp that can be made into a lemon-flavoured drink.
output.edibilityNote: The pod pulp is edible and made into a lemon-flavoured beverage; in Cambodia, fruit and, during famines, young leaves are eaten.
